snippet.title: Astrolite - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
The Galaxy stands united. The World Guardians prepare their last stand. Their enemy? Oh ... it's you. Astrolite is a survivors-like with bullet hell bosses. Aim, navigate, and grow powerful enough to destroy entire worlds.

Astrolite is available on Steam and PC - Windows only
Wishlist now
